about: P4b fix batch 3 (a question from batch 2): the database's VC entry sets the speed unit to a surface speed, and no Klartext code sets it back to rpm. VC is only ever written with its value (VC:200 on a tool call, VC:120 in FUNCTION TURNDATA SPIN), and a word with a value is read as the code it spells (VC200), which no entry is, so neither interpreter ever switches to a surface speed: an S written after a VC stays a spindle speed. If VC is ever read as the code, a rule has to set the unit back on the S of a tool call first.

states.about: A tool call with a cutting speed: the speed unit does not change.
The S of the next tool call is a spindle speed, not a surface speed.
